title: Not as impressed as I had hoped.
text: Not as impressed as I had hoped.. The Quawreath is pretty, very Fall-ish/Harvest-y. Unfortunately, it is not as pretty as I hoped. The colors are pretty – yellow, red, green and orange - but interspersed with hydrangeas, dahlias and something similar to eucalyptus. This wreath looks better and more expensive in the picture. I do like that it comes with a hook, which makes it convenient for hanging. Initially, I wanted to place this on my front door, but after reading the care instructions carefully, it said to avoid direct sunlight and rain, so I will probably put it over my fireplace. And finally, it is expensive ($50) for what you get. And while I do like the sturdy box that it came in, does that make it a must have? Probably not.
